components.name: ApplicationFrame
components.description: The product shell. Wraps a page with a collapsible sidebar and main content area.

props.name: isOpen
props.description: Whether the action bar is open

props.name: primaryActions
props.description: The primary action

props.name: secondaryActions
props.description: The secondary actions

props.name: label
props.description: The label of the action bar

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual variant of the action bar - "dark": Dark background with light text (default) - "light": Light background with dark text

props.name: leftContent
props.description: Custom content to render on the left side (e.g., error navigation)

props.name: status
props.description: The current status of the action bar. - "idle": Default state, shows an alert icon (pending changes) - "loading": Shows a spinner and disables all actions - "success": Shows a checkmark icon and disab

components.name: F0Alert
components.description: Inline alert/banner for status messages. Variants: info, warning, critical, positive. Required: `title` and `description` (both strings — no children).
components.canonicalExample:
<F0Alert
  variant="warning"
  title="Period locked"
  description="This payroll period is closed and cannot be edited."
/>

components.name: F0BigNumber
components.description: KPI card with a large numeric value, optional label, trend indicator and unit. Use in dashboard headers.

components.name: F0Button
components.description: Action button. Variants for hierarchy (default, outline, neutral, critical), optional icon/emoji, async onClick with built-in loading state.
components.notes: Required: `label` (always — used as accessible name even when `hideLabel`). For icon-only buttons set `hideLabel`.

components.name: F0ButtonDropdown
components.canonicalExample:
<F0ButtonDropdown
  variant="default"
  items={[
      {
        value: "save",
        label: "Save changes",
        icon: Save,
      },
      {
        value: "save-close",
        label: "Save and close",
        icon: Save,
      },
      {
        value: "discard",
        label: "Discard changes",
        icon: Delete,
        critical: true,
      },
    ]}
/>

components.name: F0ButtonToggle
components.canonicalExample:
<F0ButtonToggle
  label="Default Toggle"
  icon={[MicrophoneNegative, Microphone]}
  selected={undefined}
  onSelectedChange={undefined}
/>

components.name: F0Card
components.description: Container card with optional title, description, icon and footer actions. Use for grouping related content.
components.canonicalExample: Card body

components.name: F0DataChart
components.description: Generic chart wrapper supporting line, bar, area, pie. Pass series + labels; f0 handles legend, tooltip, axis, theme.
components.canonicalExample:
<F0DataChart
  type="line"
  data={{
    labels: ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar"],
    series: [{ name: "Headcount", values: [120, 124, 130] }],
  }}
/>

components.name: F0FileItem
components.canonicalExample:
<F0FileItem
  size="lg"
  file={new File(["test"], "test.txt", { type: "text/plain" })}
  actions={[
      {
        label: "Delete file",
        onClick: fn(),
      },
    ]}
  disabled={false}
/>

props.name: loadChildren
props.description: Async callback to lazily load children when a node is expanded. Used with `rootNodes` for on-demand tree loading instead of providing the full `nodes` array upfront.

props.name: deferredNodes
props.description: A second batch of nodes (and optional edges) loaded after the initial paint. Pass a Promise that resolves with additional nodes, or a thunk that returns one (invoked after first paint). Only applies t

props.name: onDeferredLoadComplete
props.description: Fired once when the deferred batch merges successfully.

props.name: onDeferredLoadError
props.description: Fired if the deferred promise rejects.

props.name: renderNode
props.description: Required callback to render each node. Receives the node data and a context object describing how F0Graph wants the node to behave (zoom variant, selection state, expand callbacks, etc.). For the defa

props.name: renderEdge
props.description: Optional callback to render custom edges. Receives the edge and its variant (`"default" | "highlighted" | "dimmed"`). Falls back to default edge rendering when omitted.

props.name: defaultZoom
props.description: Initial zoom level. `1` = 100%. Defaults to `1`.

props.name: minZoom
props.description: Smallest zoom level the user can pan to (the "zoom-out" limit). `1` = 100%, `0.05` = 5% (graph appears tiny / dot view). Defaults to `0.05`. Lower values allow extreme zoom-out where nodes collapse in

props.name: maxZoom
props.description: Largest zoom level the user can pan to (the "zoom-in" limit). `1` = 100%, `2` = 200%. Defaults to `2`.

props.name: onExpandedNodesChange
props.description: Fired with the complete new Set on every expand/collapse, in both controlled and uncontrolled mode.

props.name: onSelectedNodesChange
props.description: Fired with the complete new Set on every selection change, in both controlled and uncontrolled mode.

props.name: nodeWidth
props.description: Layout sizing hint passed to the built-in layout engine. Defaults to 256. Override for compact nodes (icons, file rows).

props.name: nodeHeight
props.description: Layout sizing hint passed to the built-in layout engine. Defaults to 56. Override for compact nodes (icons, file rows).

props.name: layoutEngine
props.description: Optional custom layout engine. When provided, overrides the built-in tree layout.

props.name: searchValue
props.description: Raw controlled search input. Renders the bare expandable search pill with no popover. Mutually exclusive with `searchable`.

props.name: searchable
props.description: Declarative search-with-popover. F0Graph builds the index from the source `nodes`/`rootNodes`, filters/sorts results, and on select: (1) auto-expands collapsed ancestors, (2) selects the node, (3) fly

props.name: onSearchResultSelect
props.description: Optional observability callback when a search result is picked.

props.name: canvasActions
props.description: Optional action buttons rendered below the search input, aligned to the left edge of the canvas. Consumers provide their own `<F0Button>` elements (use `size="md"` to match the navigation controls).

props.name: detailPanel
props.description: When provided, clicking a node opens a right-side detail panel and centers the node in the remaining canvas space (offset by the panel width). Returns the full panel configuration for the given node —

props.name: detailPanelAriaLabel
props.description: Optional aria-label for the panel landmark.

props.name: detailPanelWidth
props.description: Initial width of the detail panel in pixels. Defaults to 384 (matches F0 spec). If the user has resized the panel, the persisted width takes precedence.

props.name: graphId
props.description: Stable identifier used to scope persisted detail-panel width in localStorage. Defaults to `"default"`.

props.name: currentUserNodeId
props.description: Optional id of the node that represents the current user. When provided, a "Find me" button is rendered as the first control and clicking it centers the viewport on that node. When omitted, the button

props.name: controlLabels
props.description: Override default English labels for interactive controls.

props.name: nodeTagTypes
props.description: Tag types present on the rendered nodes. When provided, a Sliders popover toggle is added to the controls bar that lets the user toggle each type's visibility individually. When omitted, no toggle is

props.name: visibleTagTypes
props.description: Controlled set of currently visible tag types. When omitted, falls back to `defaultVisibleTagTypes`.

props.name: defaultVisibleTagTypes
props.description: Initial visible tag types for uncontrolled usage. Defaults to all of `nodeTagTypes`.

props.name: onVisibleTagTypesChange
props.description: Fired when the visible tag types change (in either mode).

props.name: nodeTagTypeLabels
props.description: Optional friendly labels per tag type, used in the popover toggles.

props.name: reserveTagRow
props.description: Whether the layout should reserve vertical room for one tag row beneath each node so the source handle (and outgoing edges) anchors below the tags rather than between the pill and the tags. Defaults:

components.name: F0Heading
components.description: Typographic heading. Pass text via `content` (NOT children). `variant`: "heading" | "heading-large". `as`: "h1"..."h4" for the rendered HTML element.
components.notes: F0Heading and F0Text are content-prop based, not children-based. Always: `<F0Heading content="..." />` — never `<F0Heading>...</F0Heading>`.

components.name: F0InputField
components.canonicalExample:
<F0InputField
  label="This is the label"
  value=""
  placeholder="This is the placeholder"
  onChange={() => {}}
  children={<input type="text" className="w-full" />}
/>

components.name: F0Text
components.description: Body text. Pass text via `content` (NOT children). `variant`: "body" | "small" | "label" | "description" | "code" | "inverse". Markdown enabled by default.
components.canonicalExample:
<F0Text content="Manage your team's payroll concepts." variant="body" />
<F0Text content="Helper text" variant="small" />
components.notes: F0Text uses the `content` prop, never children. Always: `<F0Text content="..." />`.

components.description: Compact chip/tag — exported as `Chip`. Variants are limited to "default" | "selected" only. For semantic status badges (positive, warning, critical), prefer a Tailwind span with `bg-f1-background-{positive,warning,critical}` + `text-f1-foreground-{positive,warning,critical}` classes.

components.name: OneDataCollection
components.description: The flagship collection pattern: tables, lists, kanbans and grids over a typed data source. Supports filters, sorting, pagination, item actions, bulk actions, search, visualization toggles, empty states.

props.name: autoManageBulkActionStatus
props.description: Opt-in to auto-managed bulk-action status. When `true`, a `Promise` returned from `onBulkAction` drives the ActionBar through `loading → success → idle` (or `loading → error`) automatically. Opt-in is

props.name: bulkActionStatus
props.description: Controlled status for the bulk-action ActionBar. Designed for multi-step flows (confirmation modals, server polling) where the component can't derive status from a single promise. - **`"idle"`** — tra

props.name: onStateChange
props.description: Function to handle state change

props.name: id
props.description: Key for the data collection settings and state, must be unique for each data collection and contain the version e.g. "employees/v1"

props.name: storage
props.description: Storage for the data collection settings and state: use false to disable the storage

props.name: disableUrlParams
props.description: By default the data collection reads its filters/search/sortings/ visualization/page from the URL query params on mount and reflects any later changes back into them (see `dataCollectionUrlParams`). T

props.name: csvExport
props.description: Enable CSV export action in the collection actions menu. - `true` enables export with default settings - An object allows customizing the export filename - `false` or `undefined` disables the export a

props.name: initialVisualization
props.description: Visualization index rendered on mount, before async storage/URL restore — lets a consumer boot straight into the persisted view and skip the default→restore bounce. Defaults to 0.

components.notes: For full filter/sort/pagination behavior, read `packages/react/src/patterns/OneDataCollection/` and the stories under `__stories__/`. For prototypes, prefer the canonical "table with simple columns + ItemActions" shape.

components.name: OneEmptyState
components.description: Empty state with optional emoji, title, description and action buttons. Use when a list/page has no content.
components.canonicalExample:
<OneEmptyState
  emoji="📭"
  title="No requests yet"
  description="When teammates request time off, they'll appear here."
  actions={[{ label: "Request time off", onClick: () => {} }]}
/>
